steps.name: fit rain on S4, fold m07 held out
fit t2m on S3, fold m07 held out
fit wind on S3, fold m07 held out
fit mslp on S3, fold m07 held out

notes: DEMO BUNDLE: generated data in the engine's exact format, not WeatherBench 2 forecasts. It shows how the dashboard works; replace with bundles from run_all.py --export-runs before quoting any number.
Rain truth: CHIRPS 2.0, block mean to the model grid, land only: rain is scored and weighted over land; sea cells are blank. T2m, wind and MSLP truth: ERA5.
Weights for this date are fitted without its month 07 ±10 days (out-of-sample).
Rung per variable: rain B3c, t2m B3c, wind B3c, mslp B3c.
Grid 1.5° (~166 km); values are cell averages.
Heat-wave guidance unavailable: forecasts are 00 UTC (05:30 IST); the heat rule needs an afternoon (12 UTC) value.
Wind particles: u/v members blended with the wind-speed weights (direction only, no bias correction).
